wm_contract.observe: observe(moment) -> state. moment = {moment_id (opaque sha of the sid; the sid encodes world labels and is withheld), t0, map:'wz3to2', cavs:[CAV self-states id/edge/lane/x/v at t0], state_file (locator of the saved t0 SUMO state or None), inserted_t0 (source-loop bookkeeping), crn_seed}. No cell/demand/penetration/world seed/approach_speed/closing_lane_slow/lane_counts. The state must use RSU-observable content only. Default observe = CAV self-states projected to the WM frame (N1: SUMO up lane 2/1/0 -> WM 0/1/2, s = x - (2696 - 75.44)).
wm_contract.evaluate: evaluate(state, actions, K, H, seed) -> {action_id: [J_1..J_K]}; J_k = team delay veh-s (road speed deficit + source waiting) over [t0, t0+H); draw k a deterministic function of (state, seed, k) shared by every action (CRN). Accepted return shapes: {aid: [float | {'team_delay': x}]}, {str(H): {...}}, {'scores': {str(H): {...}}}; missing ids / wrong K / non-finite raise WMContractError.
wm_contract.actions: {id, kind base|group|solo, family, key, members:[N3 member specs id/role 'hold'/params v_w,hold_s,dmax,amax,release_x[,start_s,anchor,anchor_release_x]/lane/x/v], law:'hold_speed' (a = clip((v_w - v)/1 s, -dmax, amax) from start_s until hold end / release_x / anchor passing anchor_release_x; native before and after), profile:{vid:[a_s or None]} open-loop approximation for profile-only WMs, duration_s}. The base, the groups and every needed solo are always in the same call.

api.evaluate: pkg.mod:fn(handle, state, actions, K=, H=, seed=)  REQUIRED

wm_contract.binding: --wm auto (WMA_READY.json from $WZWM_WMA_READY, ./WMA_READY.json or E:/agent-work/c4-wz-wm-port/WMA_READY.json; refuses when absent) | wma:PATH | stub | pkg.mod:factory; --wm-api evaluate=pkg.mod:fn overrides names (a 5-line shim covers a different WM-A signature, e.g. plan_wm-style evaluate(rt, record, actions, K, H)).

proposer.call: tools.wzprop.proposer.propose_moment(wm, moment_row, config(overrides), state_file=None, head=None) -> proposal row; propose_file(moments_json, out_jsonl, wm, cfg, k_matched=True, source_root=None) -> receipt
proposer.search: pool = families x member sets (<= 8 per family; walls: one zone CAV per lane, spread <= 200 m; closing pairs: lane-0 + lane-1 CAV, |dx| <= 100 m; N9 harmonize_rows when tools.coopmwm.nm_families is importable) x grid v_w {15,18,22} x hold_s {90,120,150,180} x dmax {1.0,1.5} x onset start_s {0,10,20} x release {drop, early = X_B-150 / pair_t anchor}; ~2,000-2,300 candidates per PLANGEN moment. Stages: T screen (48, K4) -> synergy with solos (16, K4) -> 2 refine rounds of one-step neighbours (knob or member swap) -> finalists (12) re-scored with K8 -> optional W3 re-rank -> top-k with <= 2 per member set; optional abstain_below.
proposer.ranking: per WM draw: T = J(base) - J(group), S = min_i J(solo_i) - J(group), M = min(J(base), min_i J(solo_i)) - J(group) (M > 0 <=> T > 0 and S > 0, the two SUMO admission conditions); score = LCB = mean(M) - 1.645 sd(M)/sqrt(K) (alternatives mean, p_pos).
proposer.wm_cost: ~1,300-1,600 action-draws of H = 300 s in 5 WM calls per moment at the defaults (measured with the StubWM on 4 PLANGEN moments); config keys n_screen/n_synergy/refine_rounds/finalists/K_* scale it
proposer.output: PROPOSALS.jsonl (schema wmc-proposals-v1), one row per moment: sid, t0, variants {wm0..wm(k-1): N3 variant (family, params, members) + wm prediction (T/S/M stats with draws, rank, score, best_solo, solo_adv, backend)}, abstain, ledger (WM calls/rollouts), finalists, n9 status, observable_inputs, excluded_inputs, backend meta (WMA_READY sha + WM-A commits); + PROPOSALS_RECEIPT.json

plugin.stages: python -m tools.wzprop verify {init|natives|geometry-moments|moments|screen|solos|rep1|rep2|analyze} --root ROOT ...; python -m tools.wzprop run JOBS --root ROOT --cap C; python -m tools.wzprop wave --root ROOT (screen->solos->rep1->rep2 plan+run, then analyze)
plugin.same_checks: tools/wzprop/n3_pipeline = VERBATIM PLANGEN pg_plan.py (e8de81f5), pg_analyze.py (cc70b0fe raw / 13326446 LF), nm2_core.py (ad6b4bd6), population.py (6af5ee23 raw / 5e8c61a6 LF); n3.verify() refuses drift; n3.bind() only repoints module globals (BASE/RUNS/LEDGER/MAPSPEC/CAP/native_dir/worlds). Admission = pg_analyze.verdict: r0, r1, r2 each LB95(T) > 0 & LB95(S) > 0 & S >= 1 veh-s on [t0, t0+300) (30 s circular-block bootstrap, B 2000, RNG 20261103), later harm T > 0 over [t0, t0+420), group arms 0 collisions / 0 teleports; solos for best-T per family, one replicated candidate per moment and arm, dithers 1/2.
plugin.same_moments: init --natives-root <N3/PLANGEN root> reuses its saved t0 states and scenario read-only (jobs refuse to write outside ROOT); moments are the source MOMENTS.json rows; source dither targets reused unless a WM member is one (then pg_plan.dither_targets re-picks; receipted). Member specs are re-derived with pg_plan.member_spec and must be identical.
plugin.outputs: ROOT/results/analyze_<tag>/WMC_SUMMARY.json (verdicts with proposer + wm_prediction, funnel per proposer, ledger sim-s), WMC_MOVES_B.jsonl (WM-verified, coopmwm-mined-move-v1, arm B, proposer 'wm'), WMC_MOVES_R.jsonl (count-matched random arm when --with-random), WMC_NEGATIVES.jsonl

api.compare: python -m tools.wzprop compare --summary <ref summary (arms B -> structured, R -> random)> --summary <WMC_SUMMARY.json> [--proposals P] [--cap C] --out COMPARE.json: per arm verified plans, verified_per_sim_s / per 1,000 sim-s (moment bootstrap 95% CI), admission rate per candidate and per moment (Wilson 95%), funnel counts, standalone sim-s per arm (shared base charged to each arm; equals the WM root's own ledger, tested); paired WM-minus-other differences; fixed-budget prefix view in an outcome-blind sha256 moment order; WM rank diagnostics; post hoc WM abstention (zero SUMO). Moments where any compared arm has a budget-stranded ('*_missing') funnel are excluded and listed (--keep-incomplete to keep). rankcheck: zero-SUMO WM ranking vs existing SUMO verdicts (Spearman T/S, AUC admitted by M-LCB, top-1 admitted).
api.wallfit: optional re-ranker: propose --wallfit-head HEAD.pt (default OFF; finalists keep WM stats, gain head.score/synergy/admit_prob, re-sorted by head score). Labels: python -m tools.wzprop labels (wallfit-labels-v1 per (moment, move), seed rows crn1..3 = r0 and the dithered replicates) from N3/PLANGEN/LOWCAV/WMC summaries + their MOMENTS.json (+ --wm-scores for non-WM variants). tools/wallfit/guard.py: WALLFIT_MAP=wz3to2 -> TRAIN 989200-989599 only in that process (unset = merge map, unchanged); 989600-989699 always refused.

caveats: Built and tested only with the StubWM (planted truth) and the fake core: the real WM-A ranking quality is unknown; run the zero-SUMO rankcheck on the 400 PLANGEN verdicts before spending SUMO.
Base = native CAVs (nm2_core). If N1 selects MAPPO u0 as the base, the verification core must change (same JOB/RESULT contract, --core PATH) and the reference arms must be re-run on that base.
Registered funnel limits: solos only for the best-T variant per family and one replicated candidate per moment and arm, so at most one verified plan per moment per arm for every proposer.

N9 families other than harmonize_rows (platoon_headway, early_merge, zipper_order, lane_balance, discharge_sync) need CACC/lane executors that the N3 core lacks: reported as pending_executor, never proposed.
Ingestion: group_lane_bank.binding() refuses world seeds outside 986000-986071 (N11 F1); N4 must admit 989200-989599 before WMC rows are ingested.
The vendored pg_analyze.py/population.py are committed LF (the PLANGEN copies are CRLF); pins use the LF-normalised sha, which equals the source content.
WALLFIT_MAP=wz3to2 is single-map: merge-map seeds are refused in that process.
